author: Karl Rock
description:
While exploring a Thieves Market in Karachi, Pakistan, I came across one of the strangest products I've ever seen: 'Saanda Oil' or Lizard Oil, a traditional remedy made from the fat of a spiny-tailed lizard.

This oil is sold in some Pakistani and Indian markets and is traditionally promoted as a remedy for male health problems, including erectile dysfunction and claims about increasing reproductive gland size. But these are claims made by sellers, not benefits established by reliable scientific evidence.

The trade also raises serious animal welfare and wildlife conservation concerns. Spiny-tailed lizards are captured and exploited for the production of this oil. The legality of hunting, possessing and trading these animals depends on the applicable wildlife laws, and the trade in Saanda Oil has been reported as illegal in Pakistan.

I discovered this product while exploring Karachi's Thieves Market, where you can find all kinds of unusual goods. This video is shared for educational
title: Would You Try This Bizarre Remedy?
